title: Causally closed CMIX 32-loss midpoint oracle with tape-isolated state replay
claim: Measure whether one additional decoder-synchronized 32-loss Byte-LSTM update, closed by the already decoded first second-half byte and followed by a tape-isolated dynamic-state replay, produces target-scale causal arithmetic archive gain on the exact qualified q1 parent.
correction_boundary: Change only the underdetermined v2 causal closure, local backward lifecycle, pending-feature ownership, replay write set, and later ordinary-update interpretation. Preserve the 64-event segmentation, 32-event geometry, all-Byte-LSTM parameter target, donor optimizer equations, P/K/F/S arm family, 16-event S rotation, populations, thresholds, and zero-credit oracle role.
non_claims: Byte 32 is not adapted: it is the decoder-visible closure target and remains coded by the parent probability produced at byte 31.
The first adapted distribution predicts byte 33, so each complete 64-event segment exposes 31 affected bytes rather than pretending that an unavailable target predicted byte 32.
The later ordinary 128-event update keeps its source call site but becomes an explicitly defined current-boundary approximation over a tape containing multiple parameter versions.
A positive oracle does not prove that a compact, forked, mixed, or prize-counted realization retains its value.
No diagnostic, ideal-bit, source-closure, or prefix result receives score credit.

sealed_source_base.derived_source_policy: Materialize a new content-addressed candidate tree from this closure only after activation. Never edit the sealed q1 source or running qm8 package.

event_coordinate.unit: one completed ByteMixer::ByteUpdate / Lstm::Perceive call on the reversible modeled stream
event_coordinate.gradient_forward_events: Predict transitions for x_s through x_(s+31)
event_coordinate.closure_event: At entry to Perceive(x_(s+32)), x_(s+32) has already been coded and decoded using OutputRow(s+31), and its target association is installed before the midpoint update.
event_coordinate.first_affected_prediction: The ordinary Predict(x_(s+32)) after update and replay emits the distribution for x_(s+33).
event_coordinate.affected_events: x_(s+33) through x_(s+63), exactly 31 bytes for a complete segment
event_coordinate.alignment_assertion: modeled_event_count modulo 128 must equal Lstm::epoch_ at every hook; abort before mutation on mismatch

P.name: qualified_parent
P.semantics: Execute the exact qualified q1 parent with the midpoint mode disabled.

K.name: detached_update_and_replay_identity
K.semantics: Capture the same window, reconstruct the same output adjoints, run the same local-32 recurrent gradient arithmetic, apply the resulting recurrent Adam and output SGD updates only to detached copies, restore the segment-start dynamic state, replay the 32 inputs under unchanged live parameters through the state-only path, clear episodic scratch, and continue with no live parameter, optimizer, native-tape, dynamic-state, probability, coder, or future-state delta.
K.required_identity: Every parent integer probability, coder transition, payload byte, archive byte, decoded byte, raw inverse byte, persistent-state hash, optimizer hash, and ordinary-tape hash equals P.

F.name: aligned_closed_window_update
F.semantics: Use the ordered target vector x_(s+1)..x_(s+32), commit one local-32 recurrent Adam step and one output SGD step in donor order, replay dynamic state only, preserve the actual closure-byte pending feature, and continue persistently.

S.name: rotated_target_association
S.semantics: Execute F after rotating the exact 32-element closure target vector by 16 positions modulo 32. Preserve the target multiset, forward tape, errors' source probabilities, parameter write set, optimizer step, replay, arithmetic order, and compute shape.

segment_start_snapshot.hook: Inside Lstm::Perceive(x_s), after the native epoch-zero ComputeOutputBptt / recurrent BackwardPass / ApplyOutputUpdates sequence if present, and before HHistRow(epoch_) and Predict(x_s).
captured_dynamic_state: each LstmLayer::state_ logical and padded lanes
Lstm::epoch_ and each LstmLayer::epoch_ as assertions, not writable replay destinations

window_capture.source_rows: Before mutation at the closure hook, copy the exact native rows for forward phases start..start+31 and all output pending factors needed to reconstruct their event-time output matrices into preallocated detached midpoint storage.
window_capture.external_auxiliary_inputs: Copy exactly the input_size_ values written by Lstm::SetInput for x_s..x_(s+31), after ByteMixer's source scaling and before recurrent hidden columns are filled.
window_capture.decoded_input_symbols: Copy x_s..x_(s+31) in original modeled-stream order.
window_capture.targets: Use the now decoder-visible native associations x_(s+1)..x_(s+32); do not use x_s or any x_(s+33+) value.
window_capture.forward_histories: Copy the source build's exact fp16 or fp32 input, pre-cell, normalized-gate, gate-activation, input-gate, tanh-cell, and layer-normalization inverse-variance values consumed by backward arithmetic.
window_capture.output_rows: Copy the exact normalized OutputRow values that actually predicted x_(s+1)..x_(s+32), including the causal obias effect already present in those probabilities.
window_capture.output_features: Use the actual post-forward hidden vector for each prediction; for the last row save current hidden_ before replay because HHistRow(closure_phase) has not yet been written.
window_capture.native_tape_write_policy: The capture is read-only. Midpoint gradient and replay code may not overwrite any already populated ordinary history row.

midpoint_update.hook: Inside Lstm::Perceive(x_(s+32)) after input_history_[last_epoch] receives x_(s+32), before the ordinary HHistRow(epoch_) copy and before Predict(x_(s+32)).
midpoint_update.loss_rows: For each local event j=0..31, error_j equals the copied normalized output probability for x_(s+j+1) minus onehot(aligned_or_rotated_target_j).
midpoint_update.event_time_output_adjoint: Reconstruct the exact effective output matrix used by each copied prediction from the live burst-base matrix and all native pending rank-one output updates through that absolute phase. The phase-96 window includes pending factors from phase 0; a window-local-only Gram correction is forbidden.
midpoint_update.recurrent_backward: Use a new detached BackwardWindow32 path. Traverse local events 31 down to 0 and layers in donor reverse order; initialize hidden, stored, and cell temporal adjoints at local 31 and discard adjoints leaving local 0.
midpoint_update.history_precision: Decode the same fp16-only history rows at the same source conversion points as ordinary BackwardPass on SIMD_ACT_F16 builds; retain fp32 gradient, moment, and master-weight arithmetic.
midpoint_update.gradient_materialization: Accumulate symbol, dense, gamma, and beta gradients over exactly 32 local rows into detached buffers. Never use NeuronLayer::err_, input_ptrs_, gamma_u_, beta_u_, or other ordinary scratch as midpoint storage unless the implementation proves complete save/restore identity.
midpoint_update.recurrent_optimizer: F and S advance each affected LstmLayer update_steps_ once, construct the donor MakeAdamParams values from that live step, and update live forget/input/output gate dense weights, symbol weights, gamma, beta, first and second moments in the donor enumeration order. K performs the same arithmetic on detached copies and leaves the live step unchanged.
midpoint_update.output_optimizer: The output layer has no Adam state. Apply one source-order W -= learning_rate_ * sum_j(error_j outer output_feature_j) update after all recurrent Adam writes, then refresh every affected fp16 output shadow row. K updates and refreshes detached copies only.
midpoint_update.recurrent_shadow_refresh: Refresh the fp16 dense gate shadow immediately after every committed recurrent master-row Adam update, matching the ordinary path.
midpoint_update.clipping_and_constants: Reuse the sealed parent's learning rates, gradient clipping, beta values, epsilon, UPDATE_LIMIT behavior, layer-normalization derivatives, padding widths, and parameter enumeration. Apply no 128/32 scale correction and expose no sweepable value.
midpoint_update.non_finite_policy: Abort the arm before any new probability reaches the coder and retain the bounded divergence receipt.

state_only_replay.restore: Restore only the segment-start hidden_ and per-layer running cell state snapshots. Parameters and optimizer state remain updated in F/S and unchanged in K.
state_only_replay.events: Replay x_s..x_(s+31) with the copied external auxiliary input vectors in original order under the arm's live parameters.
state_only_replay.required_primitive: Implement ReplayStateOnly with the exact ForwardPass numerical operations but separate local layer-normalization inverse variance and gate scratch. It may update only hidden_ and per-layer running state_.
forbidden_writes: loss, output bias, mixer, SSE, context, preprocessor, coder, payload, or archive state
state_only_replay.closure_pending_feature: Before restore, preserve the pre-replay hidden vector that actually produced the already coded x_(s+32) distribution. After replay, the ordinary HHistRow(closure_phase) write stores that preserved vector, not rebuilt hidden_.
state_only_replay.normal_resume: With rebuilt hidden_/cell state live and the preserved pending feature installed, call the ordinary Predict(x_(s+32)) exactly once. It writes the native closure-phase recurrent tape and OutputRow for x_(s+33), then advances the ordinary epochs normally.
state_only_replay.K_identity: Under unchanged parameters, state-only replay must reproduce the pre-replay dynamic state bit-for-bit before Predict. Any mismatch terminalizes K as an implementation failure.

ordinary_parent_update_semantics.cadence: The ordinary epoch-zero ComputeOutputBptt, reverse recurrent BackwardPass, and ApplyOutputUpdates call sites, event counts, parameter enumeration, and update count are not moved, skipped, or duplicated.
ordinary_parent_update_semantics.mixed_version_tape: F/S intentionally leave pre-midpoint native rows from the old parameter version and post-midpoint rows from the new version. State-only replay never rewrites the old rows.
ordinary_parent_update_semantics.frozen_interpretation: At the later ordinary horizon boundary, the unchanged source routines use the then-current live weights and moments for all retained history rows. No event-time recurrent-weight correction or output-base change-point correction is added.
ordinary_parent_update_semantics.claim_limit: This is the exact v3 algorithm definition and a current-boundary truncated-learning approximation. It is not claimed to equal either an unchanged parent graph or a mathematically exact historical-weight gradient.
